captions_note: the punch word behind the head repeats ONE word the speaker says, and the reel's style wins: when the reel has a caption style or an overall style, copy that style's typeface, case, weight and colour into the WORD STYLE block, or build with CAPTIONS=0 and let the reel's captions say the word. With the word on, hide the reel's caption for that one word (--hide-captions a-b). The room, the flash, the kick and the snap never touch the caption band
in_a_reel: make the slot ACROSS the cut: from just before the line to 15 frames or more into the next shot, and leave F_SNAP = 'auto' (the cut frame comes from clip.json). No cut after the line: F_SNAP = the onset of the next line. F_SNAP = None only when the slot ends on a cut or at the end of the reel
F_DIM is 3 or later and the picture is plain again 11 frames after F_SNAP, so the first and last frame of the slot are the plain picture
leave GRADE = '' (the reel owns the look)
WORD STYLE block: the reel's caption or overall style wins. The defaults are only for a reel with no style of its own
PUNCH is one word the speaker says (two at most). Look at work/check_edge.jpg at full size before rendering: the cutout edge decides this effect
steps: run onsets.py      # 1. prints word onsets as frames
edit the CLIP block in build.py: F_DIM, F_PUNCH, PUNCH, F_SNAP. Then the WORD STYLE block under it: the reel's own style when it has one
run prep.py      # 2. measures the speaker, cleans the cutout edge (about 1 min). LOOK at work/check_edge.jpg (full size) and work/check_sheet.jpg
run build.py SAFE=1      # 3. places the word and prints its ink box. It stops if the word is on the face or outside the safe zone
hf snapshot --at 1.4,2.52,2.72,3.35,3.39,3.75      # your own times: before F_DIM, the punch frame, word settled, last dim frame, the snap frame, after
run build.py      # 4. the clean page (no guide), then render
run check.py      # 5. frame count, plain frames at both ends, how dim the room got; writes work/final_sheet.jpg and work/final_edge.jpg
